articles.title: Selena Gomez's London Takeover: A Dessert Tour and a New Mystery
articles.summary: Selena Gomez kicked off filming for *Only Murders in the Building* season 6 in London with a playful video jumping on Sabrina Carpenter's viral 'House Tour' trend. The show's first overseas season follows a cliffhanger involving a U.K. royal mystery.

articles.title: Level Up Your YouTube: 5 Extensions That Transform Your Viewing
articles.summary: Over 20 million videos hit YouTube daily, but the platform's default experience can be clunky. These five browser extensions unlock hidden customization, better organization, and a cleaner, more honest interface.

articles.title: Kali Uchis Launches For the Girls Tour with Cinematic Flair, Reveals Finished Spanglish Album
articles.summary: At Sueños 2026, Kali Uchis debuted her For the Girls tour with a theatrical carriage entrance and revealed a completed Spanglish album. Her set blended velvety vocals with empowering messages of self-belief.
